explication: AutoSwarm’s documented workflow is to accept one task, select and coordinate agents, share context, execute in parallel, and return a synthesized result. The current `src/autoswarm` runtime handles calls, provider/host integration, durable records, approvals, and messages. The tree also contains a substantial archived OPC application with organization orchestration, tools, memory, channels, and user interfaces. Relationships in the current runtime are supported by source-index references; the broader OPC flow is described only at capability level, so its cross-component links are left unasserted.
